text: List the acronyms and EU funding of the 5 projects with the highest EU funding that were coordinated by a French organisation.
gold_sql: SELECT p.acronym, p.ecMaxContribution FROM project p JOIN organization o ON o.projectID = p.id WHERE o.role = 'coordinator' AND o.country = 'FR' ORDER BY p.ecMaxContribution DESC LIMIT 5
notes: answer columns pinned: acronym, ecMaxContribution

text: How many closed projects had a German coordinator?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project p JOIN organization o ON o.projectID = p.id WHERE p.status = 'CLOSED' AND o.role = 'coordinator' AND o.country = 'DE'

text: How many organisation participations were as a third party?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization WHERE role = 'thirdParty'
notes: L2 by value-grounding: 'third party' must map to the camelCase enum 'thirdParty'

text: How many projects used the MSCA-IF funding scheme?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project WHERE fundingScheme = 'MSCA-IF'
notes: L1: the scheme code is given verbatim in the question, no grounding needed

text: What is the total EU funding committed across all projects?
Which project received the largest EU contribution, and how much was it?
gold_sql: SELECT acronym, ecMaxContribution FROM project ORDER BY ecMaxContribution DESC LIMIT 1
notes: answer columns pinned: acronym, ecMaxContribution

text: How many projects started in 2016?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project WHERE startDate BETWEEN DATE '2016-01-01' AND DATE '2016-12-31'

text: Which organisation has coordinated the most projects?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM organization WHERE role = 'coordinator' GROUP BY name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
notes: L3: join-shaped grouping + ranking; tie at rank 1 would make gold ambiguous - checked none exists at migration

text: List the five projects with the highest EU contribution.
